verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of bank-hosted OAuth coverage, which institutions use it, or a plan to retire credential-based flows. The docs cited cover Link, Auth, Balance and other products without mentioning OAuth. Community reports describe credential screen-scraping at US banks (Wells Fargo, Bank of America), 2FA breakage and a non-bank-hosted login page. Only one comment notes PSD2 Open Banking use in Europe, which falls short of documented OAuth coverage.
